author: BleepinComputer
text: Microsoft’s November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a massive 1,235 vulnerabilities, including 66 rated Critical and an actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day. The Outlook flaw (CVE-2026-124194) can be exploited using malicious message files that trick Windows into

author: cyb3rxpl0it
text: Google patched an actively exploited Chrome zero-day: CVE-2026-125350, a high-severity use-after-free in the XML component, reported Nov 6. It's the 8th exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026. Update to 157.0.8103.50/.51.

author: opsek_io
text: Chrome 157 security update: 9 vulnerabilities fixed, including an actively exploited zero-day! CVE-2026-125350: XML use-after-free (exploited in the wild); CVE-2026-125344: V8 type confusion; CVE-2026-125348: GPU out-of-bounds write.

author: CveTodo
text: A critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the WP Duplicate WordPress plugin is being actively exploited in the wild, according to advisories published simultaneously by the...

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-116779 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. SignalWire FreeSwitch. CVSS 9.8

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-102895 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. GPUStack GPUStack. CVSS 9.8

author: sushantx010
text: GPUStack before 2.2.0 gives admin to anything that looks like localhost, even requests behind a same-host proxy. It's exploited and in CISA KEV. Upgrade, or set force_auth_localhost=true. Rotate keys and cloud secrets.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition during full core upgrades. Unauthenticated RCE via predictable, web-accessible staging paths in wp-content/upgrade. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. Affects 4.7 through 7.1.3; fixed in 7.1.4

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex Authorization Bypass Actively Exploited. On November 9, 2026, CISA added CVE-2026-123218 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

author: CveTodo
text: A critical command-injection vulnerability in FreeSWITCH, the open-source telecom stack maintained by SignalWire, is being actively exploited in the wild and has been added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

author: CinchOpsIT
text: New AI Finds Nearly 1,000 Hidden Security Bugs. OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI found 81 unknown flaws in Firefox and built exploits for 948 Linux bugs. OpenAI warns attackers could soon use similar AI tools to find flaws just as fast.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers Build Self-Sustaining AI Agent to Steal API Keys, Exploit Academic Systems and Commit Student Data Fraud

author: threatroundup
text: Etugen found the Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo naming every server swap.

author: air__security
text: A Flaw in Anthropic’s Official Skills Allows Malicious Code Execution. AIR’s research lab discovered a vulnerability in Anthropic’s official Word, PowerPoint, and Excel skills that could let attackers run malicious code on a user’s machine.

author: benerdati
text: One flag from a quickstart command turned an AI agent framework into unauthenticated remote code execution on port 8000. The framework is fast-agent, built for running and evaluating agents over MCP. Per the GitHub advisory (CVE-2026-102610), its serve command bound to all interfaces

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found. If your team gives Grok Bot agents saved logins, cookies or API keys, an attacker with a foothold such as prompt injection can read every file on the account

author: theagenticdaily
text: A single crafted link could trick Atlassian's Rovo AI agent into leaking private Confluence, Jira, and SharePoint data to an attacker. Researchers at DEF CON showed a URL parameter could seed hidden instructions that made the agent browse out sensitive data; Atlassian paid a bug bounty

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-77179) on macOS shows critical need for AI agent security updates to v0.42.0+.

author: abhiunix
text: The fable 5.2 system card has a weird prompt injection result: when fable's cyber classifier fires, the request gets quietly answered by opus 4.8 instead. In Gray Swan's adaptive coding eval that happened on 99.5% of valid responses, and about 90% of those got compromised.

author: AnycreoAI
text: Mezha headline: Claude Code exposes sensitive data on GitHub via a config issue. Run git ls-files | grep -iE '.env|.claude|settings' before you push; rotate keys if hit.

author: Airdr0p360
text: NEAR AI confirmed a Nov 8 breach via an SGLang flaw — ~100 users' account details, 18 legacy AI agents and 2 Cloud API keys exposed. Patched and restored, no crypto funds lost, NEAR Protocol unaffected. Rotate keys if contacted.

author: AIBandwagon
text: Fireworks AI told customers an intruder got in on Oct 24 through a cloud provider and reached billing data, plus secrets, datasets and partial model weights for some accounts. Bloomberg says it's their second breach in weeks. If you use them, rotate keys.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Qubole AWS Integration Abused in Multi-Customer Cloud Breach. Wiz researchers uncovered an attack campaign targeting Qubole customers, with attackers exploiting trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: cytexsmb
text: Some Qubole customer integrations had been idle for months. Their AWS access was still active. That forgotten trust became an entry point in a supply-chain attack affecting multiple Qubole customers. Between October 14 and 26, an attacker used IAM credentials from an AWS account

author: SlowMist_Team
text: A supply chain attack has compromised Ethersphere’s npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2. Attackers abused compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines to distribute malicious code across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

author: edanielfagundes
text: Another npm supply-chain attack: bee-js 13.3.0 shipped via stolen CI creds: postinstall stealer + backdoor on Linux, macOS and Windows. With valid npm provenance! Pin 13.2.0.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GhostAction Returns: Hijacked GitHub Accounts Push Secret-Stealing Workflows. Socket has tracked a new wave of the GhostAction campaign. Compromised maintainer accounts pushed a fake 'security audit' GitHub Actions workflow that steals cloud, AI and package-publishing secrets.

author: Sujeet
text: A supply-chain attack through malicious GitHub workflows compromised tens of thousands of repositories, including Uber-owned ones.

author: ESultanik
text: Some context on this attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage, a tool I maintain. A trusted external contributor submitted a PR fixing an issue. CI was green, but we requested changes. Then the contributor's GitHub account was presumably compromised.

author: W3B_AI_SR
text: Supply Chain Attack Targets Zcash, Vizor and Keplr Developers. A new GitHub account sent malicious pull requests to Vizor and Zingo Labs and published a Rust crate that steals developer secrets during builds. Anyone who built the crate, lwd-uri-util, should rotate their secrets.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: revoking a stolen GitHub token first can wipe your home folder, Socket says of a Ruby gem. strutil-core 1.0.1 poisons AI tool configs. A monitor checks the token every 45s. Socket: isolate, remove monitor, then revoke.

author: WeVerveSystems
text: Adobe Commerce before Black Friday: apply the October update and the September hotfix for an exploited flaw, rotate keys and secrets.
